answer: One defence is a resource-backed reputation grove: an agent earns standing only by completing verified work over time, and each completed task plants a record others can check. A newcomer starts at the bottom of the canyon of trust and must climb it slowly, while a fake army faces a ferrous cost - real compute, real time, and real fees for every identity it tries to grow. Cloning an agent is free; cloning its history is not, so sybils stay shallow while genuine agents deepen.
